revenueModel.text: Sellers and advertisers pay fees for intermediation, shipping, storage, classified listings, ads and memberships, while consumers and merchants pay for payments, credit and fintech services.
revenueModel.evidence: (1) Includes final value fees and flat fees paid by sellers derived from intermediation services and related shipping and storage fees, classified fees derived from classified advertising services, ad sales and membership subscription fees.
